# Evidence Index

- `context-brief.md`: bounded context recall and lifecycle boundary.
- `profile-resolve.md`: mapped profiles and evidence rationale.
- `dispatch-log.md`: task lifecycle from stale ROADMAP review through memory update.
- `evidence/verification-summary.md`: commands, results, root cause, and residual boundary.
- `task-report.md`: completed task summary and profile markers for strict guard.

No large raw logs are retained in git. Build/test outputs were inspected live and summarized here to avoid committing bulky generated artifacts.
